baseline.notes: QA gives FAIL verdict 2/3 of time due to treating vitest non-zero as absolute gate even when failures are from missing env deps

intervention: Created workflow variant (qa-overstrict-gate-workflow) with two-phase enforcement: Phase 1=DIAGNOSE (root-cause classify test failures), Phase 2=VERDICT (based on diagnosis). Initial run had infrastructure issues: agent wrote to workspace/ not work/. Fixed success_criteria to check both locations. Also discovered and fixed scenario logic bug: original before/after files had reversed operator comparison (>= vs >), making the 'fix' actually incorrect — QA caught this. Corrected scenario code so before has > (buggy LIFO) and after has >= (correct FIFO).
next_steps: Re-run baseline and workflow variant with corrected scenario. Need 3 runs each to compare pass rates. If workflow variant improves from 33% to >67%, promote soul-patch or workflow to production QA.
